sentences.english: Learn how to learn from those you disagree with or even offend you. See if you can find the truth in what they believe.

sentences.english: Being enthusiastic is worth 25 IQ points.
sentences.persian: شور و اشتیاق داشتن به اندازه‌ی ۲۵ نمره آی‌کیو می‌ارزه.

sentences.english: Listening well is a superpower. While listening to someone you love, keep asking them 'Is there more?' until there is no more.

sentences.english: Always demand a deadline because it weeds out the extraneous and the ordinary. A deadline prevents you from trying to make it perfect, so you have to make it different. Different is better.
sentences.persian: همیشه برای کار یه مهلت مشخص بخواه، چون چیزهای اضافی و معمولی رو کنار می‌زنه. مهلت مشخص نمی‌ذاره هی دنبال بی‌نقص کردن کار باشی؛ مجبورت می‌کنه متفاوت انجامش بدی. متفاوت بودن بهتره.

sentences.english: Don’t be afraid to ask a question that may sound stupid because 99% of the time everyone else is thinking of the same question and is too embarrassed to ask it.

sentences.english: Prototype your life. Try stuff instead of making grand plans.
sentences.persian: زندگی‌ت رو با آزمون‌های کوچیک پیش ببر. به‌جای کشیدن نقشه‌های بزرگ، چیزهای مختلف رو امتحان کن.

sentences.english: When you forgive others, they may not notice, but you will heal. Forgiveness is not something we do for others; it is a gift to ourselves.
sentences.persian: وقتی بقیه رو می‌بخشی، شاید اونا متوجه نشن، ولی زخم‌های خودت التیام پیدا می‌کنه. بخشش کاری نیست که برای بقیه می‌کنیم؛ هدیه‌ایه که به خودمون می‌دیم.

sentences.english: The fact that you 'can’t do' something can be embarrassing. But if you are 'learning to do' something, that is admirable. There are only tiny baby steps between can’t and learning.
sentences.persian: اینکه کاری رو «نمی‌تونی» انجام بدی شاید خجالت‌آور باشه، اما اینکه «داری یاد می‌گیری» انجامش بدی تحسین‌برانگیزه. بین «نمی‌تونم» و «دارم یاد می‌گیرم» فقط چند قدم کوچولو فاصله‌ست.

sentences.english: Don’t measure your life with someone else’s ruler.
sentences.persian: زندگی‌ت رو با خط‌کش یکی دیگه اندازه نگیر.

sentences.english: When someone tells you what ticks them off, they are telling you what makes them tick.
sentences.persian: وقتی کسی می‌گه چی حرصش رو درمیاره، در واقع داره می‌گه چه چیزهایی براش مهمه و به حرکتش درمیاره.

sentences.english: Collecting things benefits you only if you display your collection prominently and share it in joy with others. The opposite of this is hoarding.
sentences.persian: جمع کردن چیزها فقط وقتی به دردت می‌خوره که مجموعه‌ات رو جلوی چشم بذاری و دیگران رو هم توی لذتش شریک کنی. نقطه‌ی مقابلش می‌شه تلنبار کردن.

sentences.english: Taking a break is not a sign of weakness but a sign of strength.
sentences.persian: استراحت کردن نشونه‌ی ضعف نیست؛ نشونه‌ی قدرته.

sentences.english: A major part of travel is to leave stuff behind. The more you leave behind, the further you will advance.
sentences.persian: بخش مهمی از سفر، جا گذاشتن چیزهاست. هرچی بیشتر پشت سر بذاری، جلوتر می‌ری.

sentences.english: You don’t have to attend every argument you are invited to.
sentences.persian: مجبور نیستی توی هر بحثی که بهش دعوت می‌شی شرکت کنی.

sentences.english: A worthy goal for a year is to learn enough about a subject so that you can’t believe how ignorant you were a year earlier.
sentences.persian: یه هدف ارزشمند برای یه سال اینه که درباره‌ی موضوعی اون‌قدر یاد بگیری که باورت نشه یه سال پیش چقدر ازش بی‌خبر بودی.

sentences.english: You can’t reason someone out of a notion that they didn’t reason themselves into.
sentences.persian: نمی‌تونی با دلیل کسی رو از باوری برگردونی که با دلیل بهش نرسیده.

sentences.persian: وقتی فهرست کارهای انجام‌نداده نگرانت می‌کنه، با فهرست کارهایی که انجام دادی به خودت دلگرمی بده.

sentences.english: Treating a person to a meal never fails and is so easy to do. It’s powerful with old friends and a great way to make new friends.
sentences.persian: مهمون کردن یه نفر به یه وعده غذا همیشه جواب می‌ده و کار آسونیه. هم دوستی‌های قدیمی رو محکم می‌کنه، هم راه خوبیه برای پیدا کردن دوست‌های تازه.

sentences.english: Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
sentences.persian: از درد گریزی نیست؛ رنج کشیدن اختیاریه.

sentences.english: If you are looking for something in your house and you finally find it, when you’re done with it, don’t put it back where you found it. Put it back where you first looked for it.
sentences.persian: اگه توی خونه دنبال چیزی گشتی و بالاخره پیداش کردی، بعد از استفاده همون‌جایی نذارش که پیداش کردی؛ بذارش جایی که اول از همه دنبالش گشتی.

sentences.english: Movement plus variety equals health.
sentences.persian: تحرک به‌اضافه‌ی تنوع، می‌شه سلامتی.

sentences.english: Never use a credit card for credit. sentences.persian: هیچ‌وقت از کارت اعتباری برای قرض گرفتن استفاده نکن. تنها بدهی قابل‌قبول، بدهی برای خرید چیزیه که به احتمال خیلی زیاد ارزش فروشش بالا می‌ره، مثل خونه. ارزش فروش بیشتر چیزها همون لحظه‌ی خرید کم می‌شه یا از بین می‌ره. برای چیزهایی که ارزششون افت می‌کنه زیر بار بدهی نرو.

sentences.english: A great way to understand yourself is to seriously reflect on everything you find irritating in others.
sentences.persian: یه راه عالی برای شناختن خودت اینه که به هر چیزی که توی بقیه اذیتت می‌کنه، جدی فکر کنی.

sentences.english: The advantage of a ridiculously ambitious goal is that it sets the bar very high, so even if your effort falls short, it may exceed an ordinary success.
sentences.persian: خوبی یه هدف به‌شدت بلندپروازانه اینه که سطح انتظار رو خیلی بالا می‌بره؛ طوری که حتی اگه تلاشت به هدف نرسه، باز هم ممکنه نتیجه‌اش از یه موفقیت معمولی بهتر باشه.

sentences.english: When you give away 10% of your income, you lose 10% of your purchasing power, which is minor compared to the 110% increase in happiness you will gain.
sentences.persian: وقتی ۱۰ درصد درآمدت رو می‌بخشی، ۱۰ درصد از قدرت خریدت کم می‌شه؛ این در برابر ۱۱۰ درصد شادی بیشتری که به دست میاری، چیز زیادی نیست.

sentences.english: The best way to learn anything is to try to teach what you know.
sentences.persian: بهترین راه یاد گرفتن هر چیزی اینه که سعی کنی چیزهایی رو که بلدی به بقیه یاد بدی.

sentences.english: Whenever you have a choice between being right or being kind, be kind. No exceptions. Don’t confuse kindness with weakness.
sentences.persian: هر وقت بین حق داشتن و مهربون بودن حق انتخاب داشتی، مهربون باش. بدون استثنا. مهربونی رو با ضعف اشتباه نگیر.

sentences.english: We lack rites of passage. Create a memorable family ceremony when your child reaches legal adulthood between eighteen and twenty-one. This moment will become a significant touchstone in their life.
sentences.persian: توی زندگی‌مون جای آیین‌های ورود به مرحله‌های تازه خالیه. وقتی فرزندت، بین هجده تا بیست‌ویک‌سالگی، به سن قانونی می‌رسه، براش یه مراسم خانوادگی به‌یادموندنی برگزار کن. این لحظه بعدها توی زندگی‌اش یه نقطه‌ی رجوع مهم می‌شه.

sentences.english: The best way to get to yes in a negotiation is to truly understand what yes means for the other party.
sentences.persian: بهترین راه برای «بله» گرفتن توی مذاکره اینه که واقعاً بفهمی «بله» برای طرف مقابل چه معنایی داره.

sentences.english: Recipe for greatness: Become just a teeny bit better than you were last year. Repeat every year.
sentences.persian: دستور عالی شدن: هر سال فقط یه کوچولو از سال قبل بهتر شو. این کار رو هر سال تکرار کن.

sentences.english: Draw to discover what you see. Write to discover what you think.
sentences.persian: نقاشی بکش تا کشف کنی چی می‌بینی. بنویس تا کشف کنی چی فکر می‌کنی.

sentences.english: Whenever you can’t decide which path to take, pick the one that produces change.
sentences.persian: هر وقت نمی‌دونی کدوم مسیر رو انتخاب کنی، اونی رو انتخاب کن که تغییر ایجاد می‌کنه.

sentences.english: The quickest checkout line will be the one with the fewest people no matter the size of their carts.
sentences.persian: سریع‌ترین صف صندوق اونیه که آدم‌های کمتری توشن، فرقی نمی‌کنه چرخ خریدشون چقدر پر باشه.

sentences.english: Choose not to be outraged today.
sentences.persian: انتخاب کن که امروز از کوره در نری.

sentences.english: If you are the smartest person in the room, you are in the wrong room. Hang out with, and learn from people smarter than yourself. Even better, find smart people who will disagree with you.
sentences.persian: اگه توی جمعی از همه باهوش‌تری، جمع درستی رو انتخاب نکردی. با آدم‌های باهوش‌تر از خودت وقت بگذرون و ازشون یاد بگیر. از اون بهتر، آدم‌های باهوشی پیدا کن که باهات مخالفن.

sentences.english: You should demand extraordinary evidence in order to believe extraordinary claims.
sentences.persian: برای باور کردن ادعاهای خارق‌العاده، مدرک‌های خارق‌العاده بخواه.

sentences.english: Rule of 3 in conversation: To get to the real reason, ask a person to go deeper than what they just said. Then again, and then once more. The third time’s answer is the one closest to the truth.

sentences.english: Pros make as many mistakes as amateurs; they’ve just learned how to gracefully recover from their mistakes.
sentences.persian: حرفه‌ای‌ها هم به اندازه‌ی تازه‌کارها اشتباه می‌کنن؛ فقط یاد گرفتن چطور ماهرانه اشتباه‌هاشون رو جمع‌وجور کنن.

sentences.english: Don’t be the best. Be the only.
sentences.persian: بهترین نباش؛ بی‌همتا باش.

sentences.english: Everyone is shy. Other people are waiting for you to introduce yourself to them; they are waiting for you to send them an email; they are waiting for you to ask them on a date. Go ahead.

sentences.english: The more you are interested in others, the more interesting they’ll find you. To be interesting, be interested.
sentences.persian: هرچی بیشتر به بقیه علاقه نشون بدی، براشون جالب‌تر می‌شی. برای جالب بودن، علاقه‌مند باش.

sentences.english: Don’t take it personally when someone turns you down. Assume they are like you: busy, occupied, distracted. Try again later. It’s amazing how often a second try works.
sentences.persian: وقتی کسی ردت می‌کنه، به خودت نگیر. فرض کن اون هم مثل خودته: سرش شلوغه، گرفتاره یا حواسش پرته. بعداً دوباره امتحان کن. تعجب می‌کنی که چند بار تلاش دوم جواب می‌ده.

sentences.english: The purpose of a habit is to remove that action from self-negotiation. You no longer expend energy deciding whether to do it. You just do it. Good habits can range from telling the truth to flossing.

sentences.english: Promptness is a sign of respect.
sentences.persian: وقت‌شناسی نشونه‌ی احترامه.

sentences.persian: وقتی جوونی، دست‌کم شش ماه تا یه سال با کمترین هزینه و کمترین وسایل ممکن زندگی کن؛ توی یه اتاق کوچیک یا چادر، با برنج و لوبیا سر کن. این‌طوری هر وقت در آینده لازم شد ریسک کنی، از «بدترین حالت ممکن» نمی‌ترسی.

sentences.english: Trust me: There is no “them.”
sentences.persian: بهم اعتماد کن: چیزی به اسم «اونا» وجود نداره.

sentences.english: Tend to the small things. More people are defeated by blisters than by mountains.
sentences.persian: حواست به چیزهای کوچیک باشه. تاول‌ها بیشتر از کوه‌ها آدم‌ها رو از پا درمیارن.

sentences.english: You lead by letting others know what you expect of them, which may exceed what they themselves expect. Provide them a reputation that they can step up to.
sentences.persian: برای رهبری، به بقیه بگو چه انتظاری ازشون داری؛ انتظاری که شاید از تصور خودشون هم بالاتر باشه. بهشون اعتباری بده که برای شایسته‌ی اون شدن، خودشون رو بالا بکشن.

sentences.english: If you ask for someone’s feedback, you’ll get a critic. But if instead you ask for advice, you’ll get a partner.
sentences.persian: اگه از کسی بازخورد بخوای، یه منتقد گیرت میاد؛ اگه راهنمایی بخوای، یه همراه پیدا می‌کنی.

sentences.english: The Golden Rule will never fail you. It is the foundation of all other virtues.
sentences.persian: قاعده‌ی طلایی هیچ‌وقت ناامیدت نمی‌کنه. پایه‌ی همه‌ی خوبی‌های دیگه‌ست.

sentences.english: To make something good, just do it. To make something great, just redo it, redo it, redo it. The secret to making fine things is in remaking them.
sentences.persian: برای ساختن یه چیز خوب، انجامش بده. برای ساختن یه چیز عالی، دوباره و دوباره و دوباره انجامش بده. راز ساختن چیزهای عالی، دوباره ساختنشونه.

sentences.english: This is true: It’s hard to cheat an honest person.
sentences.persian: این یه واقعیته: گول زدن آدم درستکار کار سختیه.

sentences.english: Expand your mind by thinking with your feet on a walk or with your hand in a notebook. Think outside your brain.
sentences.persian: با قدم زدن و فکر کردن، یا با نوشتن توی دفتر، ذهنت رو بازتر کن. بیرون از مغزت هم فکر کن.

sentences.english: At first, buy the absolute cheapest tools you can find. Upgrade the ones you use a lot. If you wind up using some tool for a job, buy the very best you can afford.
sentences.persian: اول کار ارزون‌ترین ابزارهایی رو که پیدا می‌کنی بخر. اون‌هایی رو که زیاد استفاده می‌کنی با مدل بهتر عوض کن. اگه ابزاری شد وسیله‌ی کارت، بهترین مدلی رو بخر که از پس هزینه‌اش برمیای.

sentences.english: Shorten your to-do list by asking yourself, “What is the worst that will happen if this does not get done?” Eliminate all but the disasters.
sentences.persian: با این سؤال فهرست کارهات رو کوتاه کن: «اگه این کار انجام نشه، بدترین اتفاقی که می‌افته چیه؟» فقط کارهایی رو نگه دار که انجام ندادنشون فاجعه به بار میاره.

sentences.english: To move through a place, you may not be permitted, act like you belong there.
sentences.persian: برای رد شدن از جایی که شاید اجازه‌ی حضور توش رو نداری، طوری رفتار کن که انگار جای تو همون‌جاست.

sentences.english: Nothing elevates a person higher than taking responsibility for their mistakes. If you mess up, fess up. It’s astounding how powerful this ownership is.
sentences.persian: هیچ‌چیز به اندازه‌ی پذیرفتن مسئولیت اشتباه‌ها به آدم اعتبار نمی‌ده. اگه گند زدی، گردن بگیر. قدرت این مسئولیت‌پذیری حیرت‌انگیزه.

sentences.english: Hatred is a curse that does not affect the hated. It only poisons the hater. Release a grudge as if it were a poison.
sentences.persian: نفرت نفرینیه که به آدمی که ازش متنفری کاری نداره؛ فقط خودت رو مسموم می‌کنه. کینه رو مثل یه سم از خودت دور کن.

sentences.english: Don’t take a job because it pays the most money.
sentences.persian: یه شغل رو فقط به خاطر اینکه بیشترین پول رو می‌ده انتخاب نکن.

sentences.english: You can obsess about your customers or you can obsess about beating the competition. Both works, but of the two obsessing about your customers will take you further.
sentences.persian: می‌تونی تمام فکر و ذکرت مشتری‌هات باشن یا شکست دادن رقبا. هر دو جواب می‌دن، ولی تمرکز روی مشتری‌ها تو رو جلوتر می‌بره.

sentences.english: “No” is an acceptable answer even without a reason.
sentences.persian: «نه» حتی بدون دلیل هم جواب قابل‌قبولیه.

sentences.english: Separate the processes of creating from improving. You can’t write and edit or sculpt and polish or make and analyze at the same time. If you do, the editor stops the creator. While you invent, don’t select. While you sketch, don’t inspect. While you write the first draft, don’t reflect. At the start, the creator mind must be unleashed from judgment.
sentences.persian: خلق کردن رو از بهتر کردن جدا کن. نمی‌تونی هم‌زمان هم بنویسی و ویرایش کنی، هم مجسمه بتراشی و صیقلش بدی، یا هم بسازی و تحلیل کنی. اگه این کار رو بکنی، ویراستار جلوی آفریننده رو می‌گیره. موقع ایده‌پردازی دست‌چین نکن. موقع طرح زدن موشکافی نکن. موقع نوشتن پیش‌نویس اول، درگیر سبک‌سنگین کردنش نشو. اول کار، ذهن خلاق باید از قید قضاوت آزاد باشه.

sentences.english: If you are not falling down occasionally, you are just coasting.
sentences.persian: اگه گاهی زمین نمی‌خوری، داری بی‌چالش جلو می‌ری.

sentences.english: Perhaps the most counterintuitive truth of the universe is that the more you give to others, the more you’ll get. Understanding this is the beginning of wisdom.
sentences.persian: شاید یکی از خلاف‌انتظارترین حقیقت‌های دنیا این باشه که هرچی بیشتر به بقیه ببخشی، بیشتر گیرت میاد. فهمیدن این موضوع شروع خردمندیه.

sentences.english: Keep showing up. 99% of success is just showing up. In fact, most success is just persistence.
sentences.persian: پای کار بمون. ۹۹ درصد موفقیت فقط حاضر شدنه. در واقع، بیشتر موفقیت‌ها چیزی جز پشتکار نیستن.

sentences.english: Friends are better than money. Almost anything money can do; friends can do better. In so many ways, a friend with a boat is better than owning a boat.
sentences.persian: دوست از پول بهتره. تقریباً هر کاری که از پول برمیاد، دوست‌ها بهترش رو انجام می‌دن. از خیلی نظرها، داشتن رفیقی که قایق داره بهتر از اینه که خودت قایق داشته باشی.

sentences.english: When an object is lost, 95% of the time it is hiding within arm’s reach of where it was last seen. Search in all possible locations in that radius and you’ll find it.
sentences.persian: وقتی چیزی گم می‌شه، ۹۵ درصد مواقع به فاصله‌ی یه دست از آخرین جاییه که دیده شده. همه‌ی جاهای ممکن رو توی همین محدوده بگرد؛ پیداش می‌کنی.

sentences.english: A vacation + a disaster = an adventure.
sentences.persian: تعطیلات به‌اضافه‌ی یه بدبیاری، می‌شه یه ماجراجویی.

sentences.english: Don’t be in haste. When you are in a hurry, you are more easily conned or manipulated.
sentences.persian: عجله نکن. وقتی عجله داری، راحت‌تر سرت کلاه می‌ره یا بازیچه‌ی بقیه می‌شی.

sentences.english: Forgiveness is accepting the apology you will never get.
sentences.persian: بخشیدن یعنی پذیرفتن عذرخواهی‌ای که هیچ‌وقت قرار نیست بشنوی.

sentences.english: To cultivate a habit, switch your language from “I can or can’t do” to “I do or don’t do.” You shift the weight from a wavering choice to an unwavering identity.
sentences.persian: برای ساختن یه عادت، به‌جای «می‌تونم یا نمی‌تونم انجامش بدم» بگو «انجامش می‌دم یا نمی‌دم». این‌طوری تکیه‌گاهت از یه انتخاب متزلزل به یه هویت محکم تغییر می‌کنه.

sentences.english: Be more generous than necessary. No one on their deathbed has ever regretted giving too much away. There is no point to being the richest person in the cemetery.
sentences.persian: بیشتر از حد لازم بخشنده باش. هیچ‌کس دم مرگ از زیادی بخشیدن پشیمون نشده. پولدارترین آدم قبرستون بودن به هیچ دردی نمی‌خوره.

sentences.english: You need teachers, parents, customers, fans, and friends because they will see who you are becoming before you will.
sentences.persian: به معلم، پدر و مادر، مشتری، هوادار و دوست نیاز داری، چون اونا زودتر از خودت می‌بینن داری چه کسی می‌شی.

sentences.english: There is no limit on how much we can improve what we start with. There is no limit on better.
sentences.persian: برای بهتر کردن چیزی که باهاش شروع می‌کنیم هیچ حدی وجود نداره. بهتر شدن حد و مرز نداره.

sentences.english: Be prepared: When you have 90% of a large project completed, finishing the final details will take another 90%. Houses and films are famous for having two 90%s.
sentences.persian: آماده باش: وقتی ۹۰ درصد یه پروژه‌ی بزرگ تموم شده، خرده‌کاری‌های آخرش یه ۹۰ درصد دیگه وقت می‌بره. ساختن خونه و فیلم به داشتن دو تا ۹۰ درصد معروفه.

sentences.english: Before you are old, attend as many funerals as you can bear and listen. Nobody talks about the departed’s achievements. The only thing people will remember is what kind of person you were while you were achieving.
sentences.persian: قبل از پیر شدن، تا جایی که تحملش رو داری توی مراسم خاک‌سپاری شرکت کن و گوش بده. کسی از دستاوردهای فرد درگذشته حرف نمی‌زنه. چیزی که یاد آدم‌ها می‌مونه اینه که در راه رسیدن به دستاوردها چه جور آدمی بودی.

sentences.english: Anything real begins with the fiction of what could be. Imagination is therefore the most potent force in the universe. And you can get better at it. It’s the one skill in life that benefits from ignoring what everyone else knows.
sentences.persian: هر چیزی که واقعی می‌شه، اول یه خیال بوده از چیزی که می‌تونسته باشه. برای همین تخیل قدرتمندترین نیروی دنیاست؛ تازه می‌تونی توش بهتر هم بشی. این همون مهارتیه که توش نادیده گرفتن دانسته‌های بقیه به نفعت تموم می‌شه.

sentences.english: When crises strike, don’t waste them. No problems, no progress.
sentences.persian: وقتی بحران از راه می‌رسه، فرصت توش رو هدر نده. بدون مشکل، پیشرفتی هم نیست.

sentences.english: You really don’t want to be famous. Read the biography of any famous person.
sentences.persian: باور کن دلت نمی‌خواد مشهور بشی. زندگی‌نامه‌ی هر آدم مشهوری رو بخونی، می‌فهمی.

sentences.english: On vacation, go to the most remote place on your itinerary first, bypassing the cities, and then return to the big city at the end. You’ll maximize the shock of otherness in the remote, and then later you’ll find the familiar conveniences of a busy city to be a welcome relief on the way back.
sentences.persian: توی سفر اول برو دورافتاده‌ترین جای برنامه‌ات؛ از شهرها رد شو و شهر بزرگ رو بذار برای آخر سفر. این‌طوری اول تفاوت‌های اون جای دورافتاده رو بیشتر حس می‌کنی و بعد، موقع برگشت، امکانات آشنای شهر شلوغ برات آسایش دل‌چسبی می‌شه.

sentences.english: When you get invited to do something in the future, ask yourself: Would I do this tomorrow? Not too many promises will pass that immediacy filter.
sentences.persian: وقتی برای کاری در آینده دعوت می‌شی، از خودت بپرس: «اگه فردا بود، انجامش می‌دادم؟» خیلی از قول‌وقرارها از این صافی رد نمی‌شن.

sentences.english: Don’t say anything about someone in email you would not be comfortable saying to them directly because eventually, it will reach them.
sentences.persian: توی ایمیل درباره‌ی کسی چیزی ننویس که روت نمی‌شه به خودش بگی، چون بالاخره به گوشش می‌رسه.

sentences.english: If you ask to be hired mainly because you need a job, you are just another problem for the boss; if you can solve many of the problems the boss has right now, you are hired. To be hired, think like your boss.
sentences.persian: اگه دلیل اصلی درخواست استخدامت اینه که به کار نیاز داری، فقط یه مشکل دیگه به مشکل‌های رئیس اضافه می‌کنی. اما اگه بتونی خیلی از مشکل‌های همین الانش رو حل کنی، استخدامی. برای استخدام شدن، مثل رئیست فکر کن.

sentences.english: It is not a compliment if it comes with a request.
sentences.persian: اگه همراهش درخواستی باشه، دیگه تعریف نیست.

sentences.english: Art is in what you leave out.
sentences.persian: هنر توی چیزهاییه که کنار می‌ذاری.

sentences.english: Acquiring things will rarely bring you deep satisfaction. But acquiring experiences will.
sentences.persian: به دست آوردن چیزها به‌ندرت رضایت عمیقی بهت می‌ده؛ ولی به دست آوردن تجربه‌ها چرا.

sentences.english: You are what you do. Not what you say, not what you believe, not how you vote, but what you spend your time on.
sentences.persian: تو همون کاری هستی که انجام می‌دی؛ نه حرف‌هات، نه باورهات، نه رأیی که می‌دی، بلکه چیزی که وقتت رو پاش می‌ذاری.

sentences.english: Rule of 7 in research: You can find out anything if you are willing to go seven levels. If the first source you ask doesn’t know, ask them who you should ask next, and so on down the line. If you are willing to go to the seventh source, you’ll almost always get your answer.
sentences.persian: قانون هفت در تحقیق: اگه حاضر باشی هفت مرحله پیش بری، می‌تونی جواب هر چیزی رو پیدا کنی. اگه نفر اول جواب رو نمی‌دونه، ازش بپرس بعدش سراغ کی بری و همین‌طور ادامه بده. اگه تا منبع هفتم پیش بری، تقریباً همیشه به جواب می‌رسی.

sentences.english: To earn bliss just for a moment, send someone you don’t know a compliment for something they did.
sentences.persian: برای چشیدن یه لحظه شادی عمیق، به کسی که نمی‌شناسی پیامی بده و از کاری که کرده تعریف کن.

sentences.english: When someone is nasty, hateful, or mean toward you, treat their behavior like an affliction or illness they have. That makes it easier to have empathy toward them, which can soften the conflict.
sentences.persian: وقتی کسی باهات بدجنس، کینه‌توز یا نامهربونه، رفتارش رو مثل یه گرفتاری یا بیماری ببین. این‌طوری همدلی باهاش راحت‌تر می‌شه و ممکنه از شدت درگیری کم کنه.

sentences.english: Eliminating clutter makes room for your true treasures.
sentences.persian: خلاص شدن از خرت‌وپرت‌ها برای گنج‌های واقعی‌ت جا باز می‌کنه.

sentences.english: Don’t ever respond to a solicitation or a proposal on the phone. The urgency is a disguise for a scam.
sentences.persian: هیچ‌وقت به درخواست یا پیشنهادی که تلفنی مطرح می‌شه جواب مثبت نده. این عجله دادن پوششی برای کلاهبرداریه.

sentences.english: Experience is overrated. Most breakthrough accomplishments were done by people doing them for the first time. Therefore, when hiring, hire for aptitude and attitude, and then train for skills.
sentences.persian: تجربه بیشتر از حد قدر می‌بینه. بیشتر دستاوردهای پیشگامانه کار آدم‌هایی بوده که اولین بارشون بوده. پس موقع استخدام، استعداد و نگرش رو ملاک قرار بده؛ مهارت رو بعداً آموزش بده.

sentences.english: How to apologize: quickly, specifically, sincerely. Don’t ruin an apology with an excuse.
sentences.persian: چطور عذرخواهی کنی؟ زود، دقیق و از ته دل. عذرخواهی رو با بهانه خراب نکن.

sentences.english: Don’t bother asking a barber if you need a haircut. Pay attention to incentives.
sentences.persian: از آرایشگر نپرس موهات به کوتاه کردن نیاز داره یا نه. حواست به انگیزه‌های آدم‌ها باشه.

sentences.english: That thing that made you weird as a kid could make you great as an adult—if you don’t lose it.
sentences.persian: همون چیزی که توی بچگی عجیب‌وغریبت می‌کرد، ممکنه توی بزرگسالی ازت آدم بزرگی بسازه؛ به شرطی که از دستش ندی.

sentences.english: Following your bliss is a recipe for paralysis if you don’t know what you are passionate about. A better path for most youth is “master something.” Through mastery of one thing, you’ll command a viewpoint to steadily find where your bliss is.
sentences.persian: اگه نمی‌دونی عاشق چی هستی، «دنبال علاقه‌ات برو» ممکنه فقط زمین‌گیرت کنه. برای بیشتر جوون‌ها راه بهتر اینه: «توی یه کار استاد شو.» تسلط روی یه کار بهت دیدی می‌ده که کم‌کم بفهمی از چی عمیقاً لذت می‌بری.

sentences.english: To quiet a crowd or a drunk, just whisper.
sentences.persian: برای ساکت کردن یه جمع یا یه آدم مست، فقط پچ‌پچ کن.

sentences.english: When you lend something, pretend you are gifting. If it is returned, you’ll be surprised and happy.
sentences.persian: وقتی چیزی قرض می‌دی، فرض کن هدیه‌اش دادی. اگه برگشت، هم غافلگیر می‌شی هم خوشحال.

sentences.english: You are never too young to wonder, “Why am I still doing this?” You need to have an excellent answer.
sentences.persian: هیچ‌وقت برای پرسیدن این سؤال زیادی جوون نیستی: «چرا هنوز دارم این کار رو می‌کنم؟» باید جواب خیلی خوبی داشته باشی.

sentences.english: A balcony or porch needs to be at least 6 feet (2 meters) deep or it won’t be used.
sentences.persian: عمق بالکن یا ایوون باید دست‌کم شش فوت، یعنی حدود دو متر، باشه؛ وگرنه کسی ازش استفاده نمی‌کنه.

sentences.english: Life gets better as you replace transactions with relationships.
sentences.persian: هرچی معامله‌ها رو با رابطه‌ها جایگزین کنی، زندگی بهتر می‌شه.

sentences.english: Investing small amounts of money over a long time works miracles, but no one wants to get rich slow.
sentences.persian: سرمایه‌گذاری مبلغ‌های کوچیک در طول زمان معجزه می‌کنه، ولی کسی دوست نداره آروم‌آروم پولدار بشه.

sentences.english: The main thing is to keep the main thing the main thing.
sentences.persian: اصل ماجرا اینه که اصل ماجرا همچنان اصل ماجرا بمونه.

sentences.english: When in doubt, overtip.
sentences.persian: اگه شک داری چقدر انعام بدی، بیشتر بده.

sentences.english: To build strong children, reinforce their sense of belonging to a family by articulating exactly what is distinctive about your family. They should be able to say with pride, “Our family does X.”
sentences.persian: برای پرورش بچه‌های قوی، دقیق براشون بگو چه چیزی خانواده‌تون رو متمایز می‌کنه تا حس تعلقشون محکم‌تر بشه. باید بتونن با افتخار بگن: «ما توی خانواده‌مون فلان کار رو می‌کنیم.»

sentences.english: If you are not embarrassed by your past self, you have probably not grown up yet.
sentences.persian: اگه از خودِ گذشته‌ات خجالت نمی‌کشی، احتمالاً هنوز رشد نکردی.

sentences.english: Outlaw the word “you” during domestic arguments.
sentences.persian: توی بحث‌های خانوادگی، کلمه‌ی «تو» رو ممنوع کن.

sentences.english: If you have any doubt at all about being able to carry a load in one trip, do yourself a huge favor and make two trips.
sentences.persian: اگه حتی یه ذره شک داری که می‌تونی باری رو یک‌باره ببری، یه لطف بزرگ به خودت بکن و توی دو نوبت ببرش.

sentences.english: Over the long term, the future is decided by optimists. To be an optimist, you don’t have to ignore the multitude of problems we create; you just have to imagine how much our ability to solve problems improves.
sentences.persian: در درازمدت، خوش‌بین‌ها آینده رو رقم می‌زنن. برای خوش‌بین بودن لازم نیست این‌همه مشکلی رو که درست می‌کنیم نادیده بگیری؛ فقط باید تصور کنی توانایی‌مون برای حل مشکل چقدر می‌تونه بهتر بشه.

sentences.english: Don’t let someone else’s urgency become your emergency. In fact, don’t be governed by the urgent of any sort. Focus on the important. The urgent is a tyrant. The important should be your king. Down with the tyranny of the urgent!
sentences.persian: نذار کار فوری یکی دیگه به بحران تو تبدیل بشه. اصلاً نذار هیچ فوریتی برات تعیین تکلیف کنه. روی کارهای مهم تمرکز کن. کار فوری یه حاکم زورگوئه؛ پادشاهت باید کار مهم باشه. مرگ بر سلطه‌ی کارهای فوری!

sentences.english: Learn how to take a 20-minute power nap without embarrassment.
sentences.persian: یاد بگیر بدون خجالت یه چرت بیست‌دقیقه‌ای بزنی و سرحال بیای.

sentences.english: Paradoxically, the worst evils in the world are committed by those who truly believe they are combating evil. Be extremely vigilant with yourself when facing evil.
sentences.persian: عجیب و متناقضه، ولی بدترین شرارت‌های دنیا کار کساییه که واقعاً باور دارن با شر مبارزه می‌کنن. وقتی با بدی روبه‌رو می‌شی، خیلی مراقب رفتار خودت باش.

sentences.english: Don’t reserve your kindest praise for a person until their eulogy. Tell them while they are alive when it makes a difference to them. Write it in a letter they can keep.
sentences.persian: قشنگ‌ترین تعریف‌هات از یه نفر رو برای مراسم یادبودش نگه ندار. وقتی زنده‌ست و شنیدنش براش فرق می‌کنه، بهش بگو. توی نامه‌ای بنویس که بتونه نگهش داره.

sentences.english: Fear is fueled by a lack of imagination. The antidote to fear is not bravery; it looks more like imagination.
sentences.persian: کمبود تخیل به ترس دامن می‌زنه. پادزهر ترس شجاعت نیست؛ بیشتر شبیه تخیله.

sentences.english: Train employees well enough that they could get another job, but treat them well enough that they never want to.
sentences.persian: کارمندهات رو اون‌قدر خوب آموزش بده که بتونن جای دیگه کار پیدا کنن؛ ولی اون‌قدر خوب باهاشون رفتار کن که هیچ‌وقت دلشون نخواد برن.

sentences.english: If it fails where you thought it would fail, that is not a failure.
sentences.persian: اگه درست همون‌جایی از کار افتاد که فکر می‌کردی، اسمش شکست نیست.

sentences.english: Superheroes and saints never make art. Only imperfect beings can make art because art begins in what is broken.
sentences.persian: ابرقهرمان‌ها و قدیس‌ها هیچ‌وقت هنر خلق نمی‌کنن. فقط موجودات ناکامل می‌تونن هنر بسازن، چون هنر از دل شکستگی‌ها شروع می‌شه.

sentences.english: If someone is trying to convince you it’s not a pyramid scheme, it’s a pyramid scheme.
sentences.persian: اگه کسی داره قانعت می‌کنه که این یه طرح هرمی نیست، بدون که طرح هرمیه.

sentences.english: Don’t create things to make money; make money so you can create things. The reward for good work is more work.
sentences.persian: چیزی خلق نکن فقط برای پول درآوردن؛ پول دربیار تا بتونی خلق کنی. پاداش کار خوب، کار بیشتره.

sentences.english: Leave a gate behind you the way you first found it.
sentences.persian: از دروازه که رد شدی، همون‌طور که بود بذارش؛ باز بود باز، بسته بود بسته.

sentences.english: In 100 years, a lot of what we take to be true now will be proved to be wrong, maybe even embarrassingly wrong. A good question to ask yourself today is, “What might I be wrong about?” This is the only worry worth having.

sentences.english: Learn how to tie a bowline knot. Practice in the dark. With one hand. For the rest of your life, you’ll use this knot more times than you would ever believe.
sentences.persian: گره بولین زدن رو یاد بگیر. توی تاریکی تمرین کن. با یه دست. تا آخر عمر بیشتر از چیزی که فکرش رو می‌کنی از این گره استفاده می‌کنی.

sentences.english: The greatest rewards come from working on something that nobody has words for. If you possibly can, work where there are no names for what you do.
sentences.persian: بزرگ‌ترین پاداش‌ها از کار کردن روی چیزی میاد که هنوز کسی براش کلمه‌ای نداره. اگه می‌تونی، کاری بکن که هنوز اسمی براش نیست.

sentences.english: On the way to a grand goal, celebrate the smallest victories as if each one were the final goal. That way, no matter where it ends, you are victorious.
sentences.persian: توی راه رسیدن به یه هدف بزرگ، کوچیک‌ترین پیروزی‌ها رو جوری جشن بگیر که انگار هر کدوم هدف نهاییه. این‌طوری هر جا که مسیر تموم بشه، تو پیروزی.

sentences.english: In all things—except love—start with the exit strategy. Prepare for the ending. Almost anything is easier to get into than out of.
sentences.persian: توی هر کاری، به‌جز عشق، اول نقشه‌ی خروج رو بکش. برای پایانش آماده باش. وارد شدن به تقریباً هر چیزی راحت‌تر از بیرون اومدن از اونه.

sentences.english: Don’t aim to have others like you; aim to have them respect you.

sentences.english: The foundation of maturity: Just because it’s not your fault doesn’t mean it’s not your responsibility.

sentences.english: A multitude of bad ideas is necessary for one good idea.

sentences.english: The hard part in predicting the future is to forget everything you expect it to be.

sentences.english: Compliment people behind their back. It’ll come back to you.

sentences.english: Most overnight successes—in fact, any significant successes—take at least 5 years. Budget your life accordingly.
sentences.persian: بیشتر موفقیت‌های یک‌شبه، و در واقع هر موفقیت چشمگیری، دست‌کم پنج سال زمان می‌برن. زندگی‌ت رو با همین حساب برنامه‌ریزی کن.

sentences.english: The job of a grandparent is to grandparent, not to parent. Parent’s house, parent rules. Grandparent’s house, grandparent rules.
sentences.persian: کار پدربزرگ و مادربزرگ، پدربزرگی و مادربزرگی کردنه، نه پدر و مادری کردن. خونه‌ی پدر و مادر، قانون پدر و مادر؛ خونه‌ی پدربزرگ و مادربزرگ، قانون پدربزرگ و مادربزرگ.

sentences.english: You don’t need more time because you already have all the time that you will ever get; you need more focus.

sentences.english: The foolish person winds up doing at the end what the smart person does at the beginning.
sentences.persian: آدم نادون آخرش همون کاری رو می‌کنه که آدم عاقل از اول انجام می‌ده.

sentences.english: For marital bliss, take turns allowing each partner to be always right.
sentences.persian: برای خوشبختی توی زندگی مشترک، نوبتی اجازه بدین همیشه حق با یکی‌تون باشه.

sentences.english: If the cost of something is not advertised, it is a sign that it’s more than you can afford.
sentences.persian: اگه قیمت چیزی رو اعلام نمی‌کنن، نشونه‌ی اینه که احتمالاً از پس هزینه‌اش برنمیای.

sentences.english: Everyone’s time is finite and shrinking. The highest leverage you can get with your money is to buy someone else’s time. Hire and outsource when you can.

sentences.english: Your best response to an insult is “You’re probably right.” Often, they are.

sentences.english: Assume anyone asking for your account information for any reason is guilty of scamming you unless proven innocent. sentences.persian: هر کسی به هر دلیلی اطلاعات حسابت رو خواست، فرض کن کلاهبرداره مگر خلافش ثابت بشه. برای اطمینان، خودت با شماره‌ای که از قبل داری تماس بگیر، یا از وب‌سایتی که خودت می‌شناسی وارد حسابت شو؛ نه شماره و سایتی که اون می‌ده. وقتی کسی با تلفن، پیام یا ایمیل سراغت میاد، هیچ اطلاعات هویتی بهش نده. مسیر ارتباط باید دست خودت باشه.

sentences.english: Fear makes people do stupid things, so don’t trust anything made in fear.

sentences.english: Be strict with yourself, forgiving of others. The reverse is hell for everyone.
sentences.persian: با خودت سخت‌گیر باش و با بقیه بخشنده. برعکسش برای همه جهنمه.

sentences.english: If you can avoid seeking the approval of others, your power is limitless.
sentences.persian: اگه بتونی دنبال تأیید بقیه نباشی، قدرتت حد و مرز نداره.

sentences.english: Your passions should fit you exactly, but your purpose in life should exceed you. Work for something much larger than yourself.
sentences.persian: علاقه‌هات باید دقیقاً اندازه‌ی خودت باشن، ولی هدف زندگی‌ت باید از خودت بزرگ‌تر باشه. برای چیزی کار کن که خیلی فراتر از خودته.

sentences.english: When a child asks an endless string of “Why?” questions, the smartest reply is “I don’t know, what do you think?”
sentences.persian: وقتی یه بچه پشت سر هم می‌پرسه «چرا؟»، هوشمندانه‌ترین جواب اینه: «نمی‌دونم، تو چی فکر می‌کنی؟»

sentences.english: Recipe for success: underpromise and overdeliver.
sentences.persian: دستور موفقیت: کمتر قول بده و بیشتر از قولت عمل کن.

sentences.english: Show me your calendar and I will tell you your priorities. Tell me who your friends are and I’ll tell you where you’re going.

sentences.english: Work to become, not to acquire.
sentences.persian: کار کن برای اینکه کسی بشی، نه برای اینکه چیزی داشته باشی.
sentences.promptEnglish: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a square 1:1, hand-painted watercolor narrative illustration for an adult visual book, warm, thoughtful and lightly humorous. Create a complete new image from this description. The story shows a paid carpenter choosing responsibility for his work after the payment is already complete. COMPOSITION AND READING ORDER Three connected comic scenes within one square: two equally sized upper panels separated by a narrow clean white vertical gutter, and one wide lower panel across the full width. Read the upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, and LOWER scene last. The upper scenes together occupy approximately the upper half; the final scene occupies approximately the lower half. Use thin white gaps, no heavy black panel frames. Each scene has softly irregular watercolor endings, and clean white paper remains around all outer edges. Set the view wide enough to include every complete character, both feet or kneeling feet, the chair, table legs and all essential tools. Nothing is cut by a panel edge. Objects may naturally overlap, but torso-to-leg connections must remain physically continuous. CONSISTENT CAST The same PURPLE adult carpenter appears in all three scenes. The same LIGHT GRAY adult customer appears in the upper-right and lower scenes. They have identical medium, balanced, neutral adult builds: gently near-parallel torso sides, moderately sized arms, natural legs, neither thin and stretched nor round/chubby, no childlike or chibi proportions. No breasts, narrowed waist, protruding hips or buttocks, body indentations or gendered silhouette. No hair, ears, noses or necks. Heads are genuinely PERFECT CIRCLES with equal width and height, without a jaw, chin, oval shape or flattened lower edge, joining shoulders directly. A soft crescent of darker local watercolor under the head distinguishes it from the torso. Purple wears the SAME simple straight CREAM work apron in every appearance: shoulder straps, unwaisted rectangular bib and skirt, a small work pocket containing a pencil/ruler or small tool, and a modest tie. Gray has a plain gray body. No other clothing or shoes; feet are the same body color. Faces have modest dark oval eyes with optional tiny white glints INSIDE the dark eye, simple eyebrows and minimal mouths; no surrounding white sclera. The customer's happy upper-right eyes are small closed upward arcs; the lower customer's eyes are open dark ovals. Do not add eyelashes to either character. Purple's face changes from pleased attention to payment, to thoughtful concern, to a calm responsible smile. Each anatomically complete hand has THREE fingers and ONE thumb; use simple natural grips without extra digits, allowing normal object occlusion. UPPER RIGHT: PAYMENT AND DELIVERY A modest warm wooden carpentry workshop doorway. Gray stands on the LEFT and holds the repaired small wooden chair; purple stands on the RIGHT, smiling eagerly and receiving a small cream payment envelope. The envelope clearly reads exactly "دستمزد". Purple's attention is on the payment. Gray is pleased and unaware of any problem. The chair is recognizable honey-brown wood with a simple solid backrest, flat seat, four legs and a horizontal brace beneath the seat. On the near-side horizontal brace joint is one clearly EMPTY dark screw hole, with two small unobtrusive emphasis strokes below it. The chair has not collapsed and nobody is hurt. Keep the chair complete and its perspective coherent. The workshop background contains a few hanging hand tools, upright wooden boards, a small overhead warm lamp, a pale stone/tile floor and one modest green potted plant. A small hanging wooden shop sign at upper right reads exactly "نجاری". Keep both standing figures and their two feet fully visible inside this panel. UPPER LEFT: THE MISSED SCREW Later, the SAME purple carpenter stands alone behind a wooden workbench, wearing the same cream apron. His entire neutral body and both feet are visible beneath the tabletop; the bench's legs frame rather than hide both feet. In his hand on the image-right he holds ONE small distinctive brass screw. His other hand rests thoughtfully near his chin, with worried brows: he has realized the screw was left out. A closed payment envelope already lies at the left of the bench and again reads exactly "دستمزد". A black-shaft screwdriver with a red handle lies horizontally on the bench at image-right. Spare boards, a small tool holder and hanging workshop tools stay in the restrained warm background. A white thought bubble above him, connected by small thought circles, contains a close-up of the wooden chair's brace meeting a leg and its EMPTY screw hole. It also contains the exact short Persian thought "این پیچ جا مونده!", comfortably arranged on two lines. This inset is a thought image, not a second real chair in the workshop. The brass screw and the matching empty joint make the discovery understandable at a glance. LOWER WIDE SCENE: RESPONSIBILITY AFTER PAYMENT At the gray customer's warm, simple home doorway, gray stands full-bodied on the LEFT, surprised kindly, with hands raised near his chest. The SAME wooden chair stands fully visible near center. Purple is to its RIGHT, kneeling naturally with continuous torso, hips, bent legs and complete feet, still in the same cream apron. He calmly uses the red-handled screwdriver to place the brass screw into the EXACT near-side horizontal-brace joint that was empty in the first scene. His other hand steadies the chair. The customer had not complained or discovered the fault; the carpenter has returned voluntarily. No additional money is exchanged. Gray's speech bubble at upper-left of this scene, with a clear tail to gray, says exactly "ولی پولت رو گرفته بودی!", arranged on two readable lines. Purple's white speech bubble at upper-right, with a clear tail to purple, says exactly "کارم باید درست باشه.", arranged on two lines. Their expressions convey genuine surprise and quiet responsibility, without grandstanding. The setting has a pale peach wall, warm wooden doorframe at left, a simple patterned rug beneath the figures and chair, and a small cabinet, modest framed landscape and leafy potted plant at right. All bodies, feet, chair legs and screwdriver fit inside the scene. WATERCOLOR AND FINISH Authentic moderate hand-painted watercolor on visibly textured warm white paper. Show broad irregular overlapping translucent washes INSIDE heads, torsos, arms, legs and hands as well as backgrounds; luminous lighter patches, gently varied pigment density, soft natural bleeding and subtle pooling near some edges. Soft painted highlights, never glossy 3D shading. The character contours are darker versions of each character's OWN body color: deep purple around purple and slate gray around gray, never black body outlines. Keep cheeks within their own local translucent body wash: no sharp pink round spots or sticker-like blush. Wood is built from warm transparent washes and modest grain; backgrounds are purposeful and subordinate to faces, screw and chair. Maintain bright, gentle book illustration warmth without excessive decoration, heavy mottling, flat vector fills, marker strokes or uniform colored-pencil grain. TEXT AND LIMITS All in-image writing is ONLY the five exact connected Persian strings quoted above: "نجاری", "دستمزد", "این پیچ جا مونده!", "ولی پولت رو گرفته بودی!", and "کارم باید درست باشه." The payment label may appear on the two envelopes as described. Use correct joined right-to-left Persian, dark legible lettering and clear bubble tails. Do not place the English book sentence in the image. No extra captions, moral slogans, English, numbers, logos or watermarks. No injuries, broken chair accident, new reward, money pile, trophy, extra people or new narrative event. Keep the causal sequence clear: payment received, omitted screw recognized, voluntary repair after payment.

sentences.promptEnglish: Create one finished square 1:1 narrative watercolor illustration for a thoughtful Persian adult book. The message is that noticing and fixing our own weakness is more useful than spending attention on another person's small fault. Tell this clearly through three consecutive moments on the SAME simple jogging path, with BOTH people jogging first, yellow then stopping to notice the own laces, and yellow then sitting to tie them. COMPOSITION AND SETTING Two equal upper scenes and one wide lower scene, read upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, LOWER third. Narrow white gutters, no heavy comic borders. Soft irregular watercolor endings with generous clean white paper around all file edges. Full heads, bodies, hands, legs, feet and shoes stay inside the painting. The setting is deliberately simple to make spatial continuity unmistakable. In ALL THREE scenes show ONE broad, straight, uninterrupted WARM TERRACOTTA RUNNING SURFACE from LEFT to RIGHT. The TOP EDGE of this surface is HORIZONTAL, with the same direction and perspective in every scene. Its lower edge fades naturally into WHITE PAPER with a soft watercolor ending. No bend, fork, crossroad, perpendicular path, second lane, new sitting area or change of viewpoint. ABSOLUTELY NO SIGN, BENCH, foreground grass patch, bush island, planted divider or greenery inside the road in any scene. No decorative foreground shrub interrupting the continuous running surface. Behind the path are only a quiet simple park and blue lake. Keep environmental detail restrained: a single slender old-fashioned park lamp at the far right, distant soft city shapes beyond the lake, and quiet background greenery and a leafy tree at the left. No decorative props, crowds or competing activities. All greenery is behind the horizontal path edge, never inside the road or foreground. The SAME MAIN RUNNING PATH is used throughout. In the first scene BOTH yellow and pink are JOGGING in the SAME left-to-right direction; do not make yellow stationary. Yellow then STOPS ON THAT SAME path to look down at the own shoes, and sits directly at that stopping spot to tie them. Maintaining the same path does not prohibit first-scene running. Keep the same camera direction, straight path and simple park/lake setting, never another trail or sitting area. The entire path remains clearly visible to both sides of yellow. CHARACTERS YELLOW is a warm-yellow adult, no eyelashes, small dark oval eyes, simple eyebrows and mouth. Mildly questioning first, surprised and self-aware second, gently smiling third. PINK is a warm-pink adult runner, with only a few very short fine upper-outer lashes as the main female cue. Pink appears ONLY in the FIRST upper-right scene. No pink figure, distant runner, reflection or silhouette anywhere in scenes two and three. Both have cream running shoes with warm beige soles. Otherwise plain colored book figures, no ordinary clothes, hair, ears, noses or new accessories. FIRST, UPPER RIGHT — JUDGING A LOOSE LACE BOTH YELLOW AND PINK JOG toward the RIGHT on the SAME path. Yellow has a clear natural RUNNING STRIDE with coherent bent legs and moving arms, not two planted stationary feet. Yellow turns the FACE toward the RIGHT in a gentle three-quarter view, looking diagonally DOWN-RIGHT at PINK's ACTUAL UNTIED shoe as pink runs a little ahead. The small eye and facial marks sit naturally toward the right side of the circular head to establish this gaze; the round head silhouette remains unchanged. Yellow's eye-line terminates at PINK's shoe to the right, NOT at yellow's own shoes directly below. Yellow's arms have an ordinary balanced bent-arm JOGGING pose, with no pointing index finger. Attention is established by the rightward face and eye direction, clearly toward PINK's FRONT/GROUNDED near shoe with the two short loose lace ends, NEVER pink's tied shoe. The front grounded shoe's upper instep is visible in a gentle three-quarter view. Do not use arrows or change the reference eye design. Pink's medium neutral torso, pelvis and running limbs are coherent; no feminine body shaping. ONE pink shoe has a naturally untied lace; the other has a small proper tied bow. Angle the near shoe three-quarter toward the viewer so its upper instep and top lacing are visible, and use this grounded near shoe for the open lace. TWO SHORT thin fabric ends emerge from its ACTUAL TOPMOST EYELETS on the upper front instep and fall close to that shoe under ordinary gravity. Nothing grows from a heel, sole, ankle or back of shoe. No giant floating ribbons, detached cords, tentacles or lace connecting shoes. Yellow's OWN TWO shoes also have ordinary visible untied laces, each threaded through its own eyelets, with short separate free ends. Yellow has not noticed them. A white cloud-shaped thought bubble, linked unmistakably to yellow by small thought circles, says exactly: "با این کفشا می‌دوه؟!" The criticism concerns the actual loose lace, not that the general type of cream shoe is bad. SECOND, UPPER LEFT — NOTICING BOTH OWN LACES ONLY yellow, now STOPPED STANDING on the SAME unbroken straight terracotta RUNNING PATH. This is a pause in the jog, not a move to a different path. Feet a little apart. Here yellow's face turns DOWN toward BOTH OWN shoes directly beneath the body, with a modest surprised expression. This gaze is clearly different from the first scene's rightward attention to pink's shoe. Yellow looks only at the own naturally untied lace ends. Arms hang naturally, hands are not tying yet; yellow is not seated in this scene. A white cloud-shaped thought bubble belongs to yellow and reads exactly: "بندهای خودم بازه!" Pink is absent even from the far background. No bench, sign, grass island, foreground bush or extra path. Keep the horizontal top edge of the path and the simple park/lake background unchanged. THIRD, WIDE LOWER — FIXING THE OWN LACES RIGHT THERE ONLY yellow, smiling warmly, seated directly on that same broad terracotta RUNNING SURFACE at the same spot where yellow STOPPED in the second scene. Neutral hips touch the path with a soft contact shadow. One leg bends naturally to bring a complete shoe within reach; the other extends comfortably toward the right. Both whole legs and complete shoes remain visible and naturally attached. Both hands tie the reachable shoe's OWN ordinary short laces near the instep. The other shoe remains naturally untied until its turn. No connecting cord or impossible grip. The smile conveys kind useful self-correction, not shame or distress. No pink, other person, thought bubble, caption or final running scene. The path extends uninterrupted from left to right on both sides of yellow, top edge horizontal, lower watercolor boundary ending in white paper. No planted island or new seating strip. STRICT CHARACTER STYLE PERFECT CIRCLE heads, equal width and height, including when looking down; no oval, chin, jaw or neck. Heads join the upper torso directly with a soft darker local-color crescent beneath them. MEDIUM balanced ADULT neutral bodies for both genders, neither plump/chibi nor spindly. No breasts, narrow pinched waist, waist notch, projecting hips or buttocks. Natural shoulders, arms, pelvis, knees and ankles. Modest SMALL DARK OVAL reference eyes. Tiny inner light glints allowed; NO surrounding white sclera, white eyeball with a separate pupil, enlarged doll eyes or frightening blank eyes. Pink's few short fine lashes remain on the upper outer edges of those same eyes without altering their structure. Simple eyebrows and friendly mouths. No sharply defined circular blush spots; any cheek warmth is barely visible, translucent and diffuse. Openly visible hands have THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural occlusion during lace tying. No extra digits or mitten hands. PAINTING AND TEXT Authentic MODERATE layered hand-painted WATERCOLOR on luminous textured white paper. Show broad softly overlapping translucent washes INSIDE heads, bodies, arms, legs and hands as well as the setting, varied pigment density and restrained edge pooling. Darker golden-yellow contours for yellow and deeper warm-pink contours for pink; NEVER black body outlines. Facial marks and Persian lettering may be dark. Gentle natural shadows and warm clear color. No flat/vector fills, marker coloring, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D finish, excessive mottling or splashing. Family-friendly, humane, subtly witty adult-book art. The ONLY in-image text is the TWO exact Persian thoughts quoted above, correctly connected and right-to-left. No sign or other writing, English, captions, numbers, watermark or signature. Make the three actions and the unchanged simple location easy to understand without an outside explanation.

sentences.promptEnglish: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a square 1:1 watercolor illustration for an adult visual book. Create a complete new image of friendship across generations through making bread together. It is warm, bright, slightly playful and immediately readable, with two spacious horizontal scenes stacked vertically within a square. COMPOSITION The upper and lower scenes are approximately equal in height, separated by a clean narrow WHITE gap without heavy frames. Each is viewed from the front at a slight elevated angle that shows the tabletop and the standing friends' full bodies and both feet below it. Keep the complete wooden worktable, its legs, every foot and all important props INSIDE each scene. Leave clean white paper around the full image with softly irregular watercolor scene endings. The upper-left of each scene contains a pale cream watercolor paper-shaped heading panel. Upper heading is exactly "جوانی". Lower heading is exactly "سال‌ها بعد". No speech bubbles. CHARACTER SYSTEM Three distinct adult friends across the two scenes: GREEN is the continuing central character on the LEFT in both scenes. In the upper scene green is a YOUNG ADULT and the friend on the RIGHT is an OLDER BLUE ADULT. In the lower scene the SAME green person is now an OLDER ADULT, while the friend on the RIGHT is a YOUNG PINK ADULT. All are equally capable friends with comparable adult stature, not parent/child, nurse/patient or teacher/pupil. All have simple medium, balanced neutral adult bodies, moderate arms and legs and near-parallel torso sides. Never chibi, childlike, very thin or bulky. No breasts, pinched waist, protruding hips or buttocks, waist indentations or gendered body shape. No hair, ears, noses or necks. Heads are true PERFECT CIRCLES, width equal to height, with no oval shape, jaw, chin or flattened bottom. Each head joins shoulders directly, distinguished by a soft crescent contact shadow in a darker shade of the local body color. sentences.english: You will complete your mission in life when you figure out what your mission in life is. Your purpose is to discover your purpose. This is not a paradox. This is the way.
sentences.persian: مأموریت زندگی‌ت وقتی کامل می‌شه که بفهمی مأموریتت چیه. هدفت اینه که هدفت رو پیدا کنی. این تناقض نیست؛ راه همینه.

sentences.english: With sharp things, always cut away from yourself.
sentences.persian: با هر وسیله‌ی تیزی که می‌بُری، جهت برش رو از خودت دور بگیر.

sentences.english: Calm is contagious. Be calm to help others.
sentences.persian: آرامش مسریه. آروم باش تا به بقیه هم کمک کنی.

sentences.english: When someone tells you something is wrong, they’re usually right. When they tell you how to fix it, they’re usually wrong.
sentences.persian: وقتی کسی می‌گه یه جای کار ایراد داره، معمولاً درست می‌گه. وقتی می‌گه چطور درستش کنی، معمولاً اشتباه می‌کنه.

sentences.english: You are only as young as the last time you changed your mind.
sentences.persian: جوونی‌ت رو از آخرین باری حساب کن که نظرت رو عوض کردی.

sentences.english: When hitchhiking, look like the person you want to pick you up.
sentences.persian: وقتی کنار جاده منتظر می‌مونی کسی سوارت کنه، ظاهرت شبیه همون کسی باشه که دوست داری برات نگه داره.

sentences.english: Worth repeating: Measure twice, cut once.
sentences.persian: ارزش تکرار داره: دو بار اندازه بگیر، یه بار ببر.

sentences.english: Money is overrated. Truly new things rarely need an abundance of money. If that was so, billionaires would have a monopoly on inventing new things, and they don’t. Instead, almost all breakthroughs are made by those who lack money. If breakthroughs could be bought, then the rich would buy them. Instead, passion, persistence, belief, and ingenuity are required to invent new things—qualities the poor and young often have in abundance. Stay hungry.
sentences.persian: به پول بیشتر از حد بها می‌دن. چیزهای واقعاً تازه به‌ندرت به پول فراوون نیاز دارن. وگرنه اختراع چیزهای تازه در انحصار میلیاردرها بود، که نیست. تقریباً همه‌ی جهش‌های بزرگ کار کساییه که پول کافی ندارن. اگه می‌شد این جهش‌ها رو خرید، ثروتمندها می‌خریدنشون. برای اختراع، شور و اشتیاق، پشتکار، باور و ابتکار لازمه؛ چیزهایی که آدم‌های کم‌پول و جوون اغلب فراوون دارن. تشنه‌ی پیشرفت بمون.

sentences.english: If you can’t tell what you desperately need, it’s probably sleep.
sentences.persian: اگه نمی‌فهمی به چی شدیداً نیاز داری، احتمالاً خوابه.

sentences.english: Ignore what others may be thinking of you because they aren’t thinking of you.
sentences.persian: درگیر این نباش که بقیه درباره‌ات چی فکر می‌کنن؛ چون اصلاً به تو فکر نمی‌کنن.

sentences.english: Writing down one thing you are grateful for each day is the cheapest possible therapy ever.
sentences.persian: هر روز نوشتن یه چیزی که بابتش شکرگزاری، ارزون‌ترین درمان ممکنه.

sentences.english: If you meet a jerk, ignore them. If you meet jerks everywhere every day, look deeper into yourself.
sentences.persian: اگه با یه آدم عوضی روبه‌رو شدی، بی‌خیالش شو. اگه هر روز و همه‌جا به آدم‌های عوضی برمی‌خوری، عمیق‌تر به خودت نگاه کن.

sentences.english: It is much easier to change how you think by changing your behavior than it is to change your behavior by changing how you think. Act out the change you seek.
sentences.persian: عوض کردن فکرت با تغییر رفتارت، خیلی راحت‌تر از عوض کردن رفتارت با تغییر فکرته. تغییری رو که می‌خوای، توی عمل شروع کن.

sentences.english: If you think you saw a mouse, you did. And if there is one, there are more.
sentences.persian: اگه فکر می‌کنی موش دیدی، دیدی. و اگه یکی هست، بیشتر هم هست.

sentences.english: Don’t worry how or where you begin. As long as you keep moving, your success will arrive far from where you start.
sentences.persian: نگران این نباش که از کجا و چطور شروع می‌کنی. تا وقتی حرکت کنی، موفقیتت خیلی دورتر از نقطه‌ی شروع از راه می‌رسه.

sentences.english: Avoid hitting the snooze button. That’s just training you to oversleep.
sentences.persian: دکمه‌ی تعویق زنگ ساعت رو نزن؛ فقط داری خودت رو به زیادی خوابیدن عادت می‌دی.

sentences.english: You’ll learn a lot more if you ask people “how are you sleeping?” instead of “how are you doing?”
sentences.persian: اگه به‌جای «حالت چطوره؟» بپرسی «خوابت چطوره؟»، خیلی بیشتر از حال طرف باخبر می‌شی.

sentences.english: Generally, say less than necessary.
sentences.persian: در کل، کمتر از حد لازم حرف بزن.

sentences.english: Each time you connect to people, bring them a blessing; then they’ll be happy to see you when you bring them a problem.
sentences.persian: هر بار که با کسی ارتباط می‌گیری، خیری هم بهش برسون؛ این‌طوری وقتی با مشکلی سراغش بری، از دیدنت خوشحال می‌شه.

sentences.english: Even in the tropics it gets colder at night than you think. Pack warmly.
sentences.persian: حتی توی مناطق گرمسیری هم شب از چیزی که فکر می‌کنی سردتره. لباس گرم همراهت ببر.

sentences.english: The work on any worthy project is endless, infinite. You cannot limit the work, so you must limit your hours. Your time, not the work, is the only thing you can manage.
sentences.persian: کارِ هر پروژه‌ی ارزشمندی تمومی نداره. نمی‌تونی کار رو محدود کنی، پس ساعت‌هایی رو که پاش می‌ذاری محدود کن. تنها چیزی که دست توئه وقتته، نه حجم کار.

sentences.english: You can reduce the annoyance of someone’s stupid belief by increasing your understanding of why they believe it.
sentences.persian: اگه بهتر بفهمی چرا کسی یه باور احمقانه داره، اون باور کمتر اذیتت می‌کنه.

sentences.english: This is the best time ever to make something. None of the greatest, coolest creations 20 years from now have been invented yet. You are not late.
sentences.persian: الان بهترین زمان برای ساختن چیزیه. هیچ‌کدوم از بزرگ‌ترین و جذاب‌ترین ساخته‌های بیست سال دیگه هنوز اختراع نشده‌ان. دیر نرسیدی.

sentences.english: To transcend the influence of your heroes, copy them shamelessly like a student until you get them out of your system. That is the way of all masters.
sentences.persian: برای اینکه از زیر سایه‌ی قهرمان‌هات بیرون بیای، مثل یه شاگرد بی‌خجالت ازشون تقلید کن، تا کم‌کم ازشون عبور کنی. راه همه‌ی استادها همین بوده.

sentences.english: Things do not need to be perfect to be wonderful. Especially weddings.
sentences.persian: برای فوق‌العاده بودن لازم نیست همه‌چیز بی‌نقص باشه؛ مخصوصاً عروسی.

sentences.english: When you are stuck, sleep on it. Give your subconscious an assignment while you sleep. You’ll have an answer in the morning.
sentences.persian: وقتی گیر کردی، بذارش برای بعد از یه خواب. موقع خواب یه مسئله به ناخودآگاهت بسپر. صبح یه جواب خواهی داشت.

sentences.english: All the greatest prizes in life, in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from the magic of compounding interest by amplifying small steady gains. All you need for abundance is to keep adding 1% more than you subtract on a regular basis.
sentences.persian: بزرگ‌ترین پاداش‌های زندگی، چه در ثروت و رابطه و چه در دانش، از جادوی سود مرکب میان؛ از جمع شدن و رشد کردن دستاوردهای کوچیک و پیوسته. برای رسیدن به فراوونی کافیه مرتب یه درصد بیشتر از چیزی که کم می‌کنی، اضافه کنی.

sentences.english: You can eat any dessert you want if you take only three bites.
sentences.persian: هر دسری دلت می‌خواد بخور، به شرطی که فقط سه لقمه بخوری.

sentences.english: Don’t treat people as bad as they are. Treat them as good as you are.
sentences.persian: با آدم‌ها به بدیِ خودشون رفتار نکن؛ به خوبیِ خودت رفتار کن.

sentences.english: Children totally accept—and crave—family rules. “In our family we have a rule for X” is the only excuse a parent needs for setting a family policy. In fact, “I have a rule for X” is the only excuse you need for your own personal policies.
sentences.persian: بچه‌ها قانون‌های خانوادگی رو کاملاً می‌پذیرن و حتی بهشون نیاز دارن. برای تعیین یه قاعده، همین که بگی «توی خانواده‌ی ما برای این موضوع یه قانون داریم» کافیه. برای قاعده‌های شخصی خودت هم همین کافیه: «من برای این موضوع یه قانون دارم.»

sentences.english: When you confront a stuck bolt or screw: righty tighty, lefty loosey.
sentences.persian: وقتی به پیچ یا مهره‌ی گیرکرده می‌رسی، یادت باشه: به راست سفت می‌شه، به چپ باز می‌شه.

sentences.english: Bad things can happen fast, but almost all good things happen slowly.
sentences.persian: اتفاق‌های بد می‌تونن خیلی سریع بیفتن، ولی تقریباً همه‌ی اتفاق‌های خوب آروم‌آروم رخ می‌دن.

sentences.english: We are not a body that carries a soul. We are a soul that is assigned a body, not of our choosing, but in our care.
sentences.persian: ما بدنی نیستیم که روحی رو با خودش حمل می‌کنه؛ روحی هستیم که بدنی بهش سپرده شده. خودمون انتخابش نکردیم، ولی مراقبتش با ماست.

sentences.english: If your goal does not have a schedule, it is a dream.
sentences.persian: اگه هدفت زمان‌بندی نداره، فقط یه رؤیاست.

sentences.english: Be a good ancestor. Do something a future generation will thank you for. A simple thing is to plant a tree.
sentences.persian: نیای خوبی باش. کاری کن که نسل‌های بعدی بابتش ازت تشکر کنن. یه کار ساده‌اش کاشتن یه درخته.

sentences.english: People can’t remember more than three points from a speech.
sentences.persian: آدم‌ها از یه سخنرانی بیشتر از سه نکته یادشون نمی‌مونه.

sentences.english: The greatest breakthroughs are missed because they look like really hard work.
sentences.persian: بزرگ‌ترین فرصت‌های پیشرفت از دست می‌رن، چون ظاهرشون شبیه یه کار خیلی سخته.

sentences.english: To be remarkable, read books.
sentences.persian: برای متفاوت و به‌یادموندنی بودن، کتاب بخون.

sentences.english: Finite games are played to win or lose. Infinite games are played to keep the game going. Seek out infinite games because they yield unlimited rewards.
sentences.persian: بازی‌های محدود رو برای برد و باخت بازی می‌کنیم؛ بازی‌های بی‌پایان رو برای ادامه پیدا کردن بازی. دنبال بازی‌های بی‌پایان باش، چون پاداش‌هاشون هم حد و مرز نداره.

sentences.english: To succeed, get other people to pay you; to become wealthy, help other people to succeed.
sentences.persian: برای موفق شدن، کاری کن بقیه بهت پول بدن؛ برای ثروتمند شدن، به بقیه کمک کن موفق بشن.

sentences.english: Your behavior, not your opinions, will change the world.
sentences.persian: رفتارت دنیا رو عوض می‌کنه، نه نظراتت.

sentences.english: A problem that can easily be solved with money is not really a problem because its solution is obvious. Focus on problems with non-obvious solutions.
sentences.persian: مشکلی که به‌آسونی با پول حل می‌شه، واقعاً مشکل نیست؛ چون راه‌حلش روشنه. روی مشکل‌هایی تمرکز کن که راه‌حل سرراست ندارن.

sentences.english: Every person you meet knows an amazing lot about something you know virtually nothing about. It won’t be obvious, and your job is to discover what it is.
sentences.persian: هر کسی که می‌بینی، درباره‌ی چیزی که تو تقریباً هیچی ازش نمی‌دونی، کلی چیز حیرت‌انگیز بلده. این موضوع از ظاهرش معلوم نیست؛ کار تو اینه که پیداش کنی.

sentences.english: Cultivate an allergy to average.
sentences.persian: خودت رو به معمولی بودن حساس کن.

sentences.english: To combat an adversary, become their friend.
sentences.persian: برای مقابله با دشمنت، دوستش شو.

sentences.english: If you are buying stock, the person selling it thinks it is worth less than you do. If you are selling, they think it is worth more than you do. Each time you are ready to buy or sell stock, ask yourself: "What do I know that they don’t?"
sentences.persian: وقتی سهام می‌خری، فروشنده فکر می‌کنه کمتر از چیزی که تو فکر می‌کنی می‌ارزه. وقتی می‌فروشی، خریدار فکر می‌کنه بیشتر می‌ارزه. هر بار قبل از خرید یا فروش از خودت بپرس: «من چی می‌دونم که اون نمی‌دونه؟»

sentences.english: You don’t marry a person; you marry a family.
sentences.persian: با یه نفر ازدواج نمی‌کنی؛ با یه خانواده ازدواج می‌کنی.

sentences.english: Be nice to your children because they are going to choose your nursing home.
sentences.persian: با بچه‌هات مهربون باش؛ قراره اونا خونه‌ی سالمندان تو رو انتخاب کنن.

sentences.english: About 99% of the time, the right time is right now.
sentences.persian: حدود ۹۹ درصد مواقع، وقت مناسب همین الانه.

sentences.english: All guns are loaded.
sentences.persian: همه‌ی اسلحه‌ها پرن.

sentences.english: Cultivate 12 people who love you because they are worth more than 12 million people who like you.
sentences.persian: رابطه‌ات رو با دوازده نفری که عاشقت هستن پرورش بده؛ اونا از دوازده میلیون نفری که ازت خوششون میاد باارزش‌ترن.

sentences.english: Always be quick to give credit and to take blame.
sentences.persian: همیشه در به رسمیت شناختن سهم بقیه و پذیرفتن تقصیر خودت پیش‌قدم باش.

sentences.english: Be frugal in all things except in your passions. Select a few interests that you gleefully splurge on. In fact, be all-around thrifty so that you can splurge on your passions.
sentences.persian: توی همه‌چیز صرفه‌جو باش، جز علاقه‌هات. چند علاقه رو انتخاب کن که با دل خوش براشون ولخرجی کنی. اصلاً توی بقیه‌ی چیزها صرفه‌جویی کن تا بتونی برای چیزهایی که عاشقشونی دست‌ودل‌باز باشی.

sentences.english: To manage yourself, use your head; to manage others, use your heart.
sentences.persian: برای مدیریت خودت از عقلت کمک بگیر؛ برای مدیریت بقیه از دلت.

sentences.english: Dance with your hips.
sentences.persian: موقع رقص، باسنت رو هم به حرکت دربیار.

sentences.english: Don’t let your email inbox become your to-do list run by others.
sentences.persian: نذار صندوق ایمیلت به فهرست کارهایی تبدیل بشه که بقیه برات تعیین می‌کنن.

sentences.english: The best way to untangle a knotty tangle is not to “untie” the knots but to keep pulling the loops apart wider and wider. Just make the mess as big, loose, and open as possible. As you open up the knots, they will unravel themselves. Works on cords, strings, hoses, yarns, or electronic cables.
sentences.persian: برای باز کردن یه کلاف گره‌خورده، به‌جای ور رفتن با تک‌تک گره‌ها، حلقه‌ها رو از هم دور کن و بزرگ‌ترشون کن. کلاف رو تا می‌تونی باز، شل و پهن کن. گره‌ها که فضا پیدا کنن، خودشون باز می‌شن. این روش برای طناب، نخ، شلنگ، کاموا و کابل جواب می‌ده.

sentences.english: Take one simple thing—almost anything—but take it extremely seriously, as if it is the only thing in the world—or maybe the entire world is in it—and by taking it seriously, you’ll light up the sky.
sentences.persian: یه چیز ساده رو انتخاب کن، تقریباً هر چیزی، و خیلی جدی بگیرش؛ انگار تنها چیز دنیاست یا تمام دنیا توی اون جا شده. با همین جدی گرفتن، آسمون رو روشن می‌کنی.

sentences.english: When making something, always get a few extras—extra material, extra parts, extra space, extra finishes. The extras serve as backups for mistakes, reduce stress, and fill your inventory for the future. They are the cheapest insurance.

sentences.english: No one is as impressed with your possessions as you are.
sentences.persian: هیچ‌کس به اندازه‌ی خودت تحت‌تأثیر دارایی‌هات نیست.

sentences.english: Don’t ever work for someone you don’t want to become.
sentences.persian: هیچ‌وقت برای کسی کار نکن که دلت نمی‌خواد شبیهش بشی.

sentences.english: No secrets. You are much better off delivering unwelcome news to someone yourself directly. A secret is rarely unknown, which means inevitably someone else will share it. Meanwhile, the secret corrodes all who hold it. Resist accepting secrets.
sentences.persian: رازداری نکن. خیلی بهتره خبر ناخوشایند رو خودت مستقیم به طرف بگی. راز به‌ندرت واقعاً پنهونه؛ بالاخره یکی دیگه می‌گه. تا اون موقع هم از درون همه‌ی کسایی رو که نگهش داشتن می‌خوره. زیر بار شنیدن و نگه داشتن راز نرو.

sentences.english: The expanding universe is overflowing with abundance. It is so full that improvement can often be gained only by subtracting. Keep removing, until you can’t. End with wanting more, not less.
sentences.persian: جهانِ در حال گسترش، پر از فراوونیه. اون‌قدر پُره که خیلی وقت‌ها بهتر شدن فقط با کم کردن ممکنه. حذف کن تا دیگه چیزی برای حذف کردن نمونه. جایی تموم کن که دلت بیشتر بخواد، نه کمتر.

sentences.english: Figure out what time of day you are most productive and protect that time period.
sentences.persian: پیدا کن کدوم ساعت روز بازدهت بیشتره و از اون وقت محافظت کن.

sentences.english: Experiences are fun and having influence is rewarding, but only mattering makes us happy. Do stuff that matters.
sentences.persian: تجربه کردن لذت‌بخشه و اثرگذار بودن پاداش داره، ولی فقط مهم و باارزش بودن کاری که می‌کنیم خوشحالمون می‌کنه. کاری بکن که اهمیت داشته باشه.

sentences.english: Greatness is incompatible with optimizing in the short term. To achieve greatness requires a long view. Raise your time horizon to raise your goal.
sentences.persian: بزرگی با دنبال بهترین نتیجه‌ی کوتاه‌مدت بودن جور درنمیاد. برای رسیدن به بزرگی باید دور رو ببینی. افق زمانی‌ت رو بلندتر کن تا هدفت بالاتر بره.

sentences.english: Most wonderful things quickly become unwonderful if they are repeated too often. Once-in-a-life is often the optimal interval.
sentences.persian: بیشتر چیزهای شگفت‌انگیز اگه زیادی تکرار بشن، خیلی زود شگفتی‌شون رو از دست می‌دن. خیلی وقت‌ها «یه بار در عمر» بهترین فاصله‌ی تکراره.

sentences.english: When you open paint, even a tiny bit, it will always find its way to your clothes no matter how careful you are. Dress accordingly.
sentences.persian: درِ قوطی رنگ رو که باز کنی، حتی برای یه ذره رنگ، هرقدر هم مراقب باشی بالاخره راهش رو به لباس‌هات پیدا می‌کنه. با همین حساب لباس بپوش.

sentences.english: You have to first follow the rules with diligence in order to break them productively.
sentences.persian: برای اینکه شکستن قانون‌ها نتیجه‌ی خوبی بده، اول باید با دقت ازشون پیروی کرده باشی.

sentences.english: If you stop to listen to a musician or street performer for more than a minute, you owe them a dollar.
sentences.persian: اگه بیشتر از یه دقیقه برای شنیدن موسیقی یا دیدن اجرای خیابونی ایستادی، یه دلار به اجراکننده بدهکاری.

sentences.english: Learning probability and statistics is far more useful than learning algebra and calculus.
sentences.persian: یاد گرفتن آمار و احتمال خیلی به‌دردبخورتر از یاد گرفتن جبر و حساب دیفرانسیل و انتگراله.

sentences.english: If winning becomes too important in a game, change the rules to make it more fun. Changing rules can become the new game.
sentences.persian: اگه بردن توی یه بازی زیادی مهم شد، قانون‌ها رو عوض کن تا بازی لذت‌بخش‌تر بشه. عوض کردن قانون‌ها خودش می‌تونه بازی تازه‌ای باشه.

sentences.english: The greatest teacher is called “doing.”
sentences.persian: اسم بزرگ‌ترین معلم، «انجام دادن»ه.

sentences.english: Anything you say before the word “but” does not count.
sentences.persian: هرچی قبل از «اما» می‌گی، حساب نیست.

sentences.english: Courtesy costs nothing. When you borrow something, return it cleaned. Lower the toilet seat after use. Let the car in front of you merge. Return shopping carts to their designated areas. Let the people in the elevator exit before you enter. These courtesies are free.
sentences.persian: ادب خرجی نداره. چیزی رو که قرض گرفتی تمیز پس بده. بعد از استفاده، نشیمن توالت رو پایین بذار. راه بده ماشین جلویی وارد خطت بشه. چرخ خرید رو سر جاش برگردون. قبل از ورود به آسانسور، بذار بقیه بیرون بیان. این رعایت کردن‌ها مجانی‌ان.

sentences.english: Whenever there is an argument between two sides, find the third side.
sentences.persian: هر وقت بین دو طرف بحثی هست، طرف سوم رو پیدا کن.

sentences.english: The consistency of your endeavors (exercise, companionship, work) is more important than the quantity. Nothing beats small things done every day, which is way more important than what you do occasionally.
sentences.persian: پیوستگی تلاشت، چه توی ورزش و دوستی و چه توی کار، از مقدارش مهم‌تره. هیچ‌چیز به پای کارهای کوچیکی که هر روز انجام می‌دی نمی‌رسه؛ خیلی مهم‌تر از کارهایین که گهگاه می‌کنی.

sentences.english: When you lead, your real job is to create more leaders, not more followers.
sentences.persian: وقتی رهبری می‌کنی، کار اصلی‌ت پرورش رهبرهای بیشتره، نه پیروهای بیشتر.

sentences.english: It is the duty of a teacher to get everything out of a student, and the duty of a student to get everything out of a teacher.
sentences.persian: وظیفه‌ی معلم اینه که همه‌ی توان شاگرد رو شکوفا کنه؛ وظیفه‌ی شاگرد هم اینه که هرچی می‌تونه از معلم یاد بگیره.

sentences.english: Efficiency is highly overrated; goofing off is highly underrated. Regularly scheduled sabbaths, sabbaticals, vacations, breaks, aimless walks, and time off are essential for top performance of any kind. The best work ethic requires a good rest ethic.
sentences.persian: به بازدهی زیادی بها می‌دیم و به بی‌خیال چرخیدن زیادی کم. استراحت هفتگی، مرخصی بلندمدت، تعطیلات، وقفه، پیاده‌روی بی‌هدف و وقت آزادِ منظم، برای عالی کار کردن ضروری‌ان. خوب کار کردن، خوب استراحت کردن هم می‌خواد.

sentences.english: Speak confidently as if you are right, but listen carefully as if you are wrong.
sentences.persian: با اطمینان حرف بزن، انگار حق با توئه؛ با دقت گوش بده، انگار اشتباه می‌کنی.

sentences.english: Productivity is often a distraction. Don’t aim for better ways to get through your tasks as quickly as possible. Instead, aim for better tasks that you never want to stop doing.
sentences.persian: بهره‌وری خیلی وقت‌ها حواس‌پرتیه. فقط دنبال راهی نباش که کارهات رو هرچه زودتر تموم کنی؛ دنبال کارهای بهتری باش که دلت نخواد از انجامشون دست بکشی.

sentences.english: Your enjoyment of travel is inversely proportional to the size of your luggage. This is 100% true of backpacking. It is liberating to realize how little you really need.
sentences.persian: هرچی بارت توی سفر بیشتر باشه، لذتت کمتر می‌شه. این حرف درباره‌ی کوله‌گردی صددرصد درسته. فهمیدن اینکه واقعاً چقدر کم نیاز داری، آزادت می‌کنه.

sentences.english: Ask funders for money and they’ll give you advice; but ask for advice and they’ll give you money.
sentences.persian: از سرمایه‌گذار پول بخواه، نصیحتت می‌کنه؛ ازش مشورت بخواه، بهت پول می‌ده.

sentences.english: The biggest lie we tell ourselves is “I don’t need to write this down because I will remember it.”
sentences.persian: بزرگ‌ترین دروغی که به خودمون می‌گیم اینه: «لازم نیست بنویسمش؛ یادم می‌مونه.»

sentences.english: Criticize in private, praise in public.
sentences.persian: توی خلوت انتقاد کن، جلوی جمع تعریف کن.

sentences.english: Don’t keep making the same mistakes; try to make new mistakes.

sentences.english: Your growth as a mature being is measured by the number of uncomfortable conversations you are willing to have.
sentences.persian: میزان پختگی‌ت رو می‌شه از تعداد گفت‌وگوهای سخت و ناراحت‌کننده‌ای فهمید که حاضری انجام بدی.

sentences.english: Handy measure: The distance between the fingertips of your outstretched arms at shoulder level is roughly your height.
sentences.persian: یه اندازه‌گیری دم‌دستی: وقتی دست‌هات رو هم‌سطح شونه به دو طرف باز می‌کنی، فاصله‌ی نوک انگشت‌های دو دستت تقریباً به اندازه‌ی قدته.

sentences.english: Don’t buy anything late at night. There is nothing you need to buy that cannot wait till tomorrow morning.
sentences.persian: آخر شب چیزی نخر. هیچ خریدی نیست که نشه تا فردا صبح صبر کرد.

sentences.english: When you have good news and bad news, give the bad news first because we remember how things end more than how they begin. So, elevate the ending with good news.
sentences.persian: اگه هم خبر خوب داری هم خبر بد، اول خبر بد رو بگو؛ چون آخر ماجرا بیشتر از اولش یادمون می‌مونه. پایانش رو با خبر خوب خوشایند کن.

sentences.english: Immediately pay what you owe to vendors, workers, contractors. If you do, they will go out of their way to work with you first next time.
sentences.persian: بدهی‌ت به فروشنده، کارگر و پیمانکار رو فوری پرداخت کن. این‌طوری دفعه‌ی بعد برای اینکه اول کار تو رو انجام بدن، از هیچ تلاشی دریغ نمی‌کنن.

sentences.english: The four most powerful words in any negotiation should be uttered by you: “Can you do better?”
sentences.persian: توی هر مذاکره، این سؤال قدرتمند رو تو بپرس: «بهتر از این هم می‌شه؟»

sentences.english: Three things you need: the ability to not give up something till it works, the ability to give up something that does not work, and the trust in other people to help you distinguish between the two.
